tasks.short: Recommend costume vendors and monitor their actual work.

steps.what: Locate actual costume vendor portfolios, quotes and prior work references
inputs: actual current vendor submissions and prior work records

steps.what: Assess and recommend vendors against actual costume quality, fit, budget and schedule needs
outputs: actual substantiated vendor recommendation and relevant concerns

steps.what: Monitor actual vendor costume work, fittings and progress and discuss necessary corrections
inputs: actual vendor work and production deadlines
outputs: actual captured vendor-work observations, corrections and outstanding issues

steps.what: Write and check assigned vendor recommendations and actual monitoring outcomes in the internal record
inputs: actual substantiated vendor recommendation and relevant concerns
actual captured vendor-work observations, corrections and outstanding issues
outputs: checked saved actual vendor recommendation and monitoring record

tasks.design: Configure production-linked vendor references in {DOCS}/{PROCUREMENT} to reduce repeat locating. Keep actual vendor choice reasoning, physical costume-work monitoring and live corrective discussion, plus actually assigned written recommendations and outcome records.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current vendor portfolios, quotes and relevant prior work can be scattered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native supplier reference links can reduce locating without ranking artistic suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Costume quality, fit, reliability and stage-readiness need actual observation.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant finds a vendor's finish unsuitable for the actual performance and fitting needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintained supplier-reference links can assist costume-vendor preparation while quality judgement and monitoring remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three navigation points only. Actual vendor supplies portfolio/quote revision, relevant work and availability; production owner supplies actual requirements. Attendant checks relevance and obtains missing details manually. Actual monitoring45 includes observation capture, not a free transcript or progress feed.

Written record15 includes actual assigned recommendation/outcome writing and checking; remove/reweight if not owned. Ordinary internal saving is ungated with no saving. No contract order, payment approval, formal acceptance or electronic vendor send is assumed. Existing reference links receive no new credit.
unknowns: Which vendor references are already maintained and which written records are actually assigned?
research_questions: Can production-linked references preserve actual quote revision and relevant costume examples?

incremental.description: Maintain vendor-reference revisions and production relevance links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 vendor-reference navigation points minus0.5 upkeep=2.5. Low: a new costume craft needs fresh portfolio investigation, leaving only0.8 familiar supplier/quote locating point removable, minus0.5=0.3. Recommendation judgement, actual work monitoring and complete written records remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce vendor-reference navigation while retaining costume quality decisions.
skills_to_grow: Maintain current vendor and production references
Capture actual fit and workmanship issues clearly
role.ambitious_version: Keep vendor evidence traceable without automating artistic or stage-readiness judgement.
